title: Release publish
description: Signs a Sparkle feed for each disk image an export folder holds with generate_appcast under SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY, pointing at the image's asset on the GitHub release nx release tags the archived app's version with, and uploads it to the R2 bucket SPARKLE_FEED_BUCKET names at the path of the app's SUFeedURL through cf r2 objects put; runs through nx release publish
